name: lighthouse-editor-tests
description: Browser tests: the extension's content scripts against real editors (ProseMirror, Lexical, Quill, CodeMirror 6) and the settings popup

scripts.test:editing: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 brackets.test.js tidy.test.js owed-space.test.js rich-text.test.js undo.test.js code-editor.test.js
scripts.test:writing: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 snippets.test.js send.test.js
scripts.test:geometry: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 handles.test.js caret-bar.test.js snapping.test.js selection-text.test.js
scripts.test:features: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 features.test.js popup.test.js units.test.js
